applicabilityBasis.summary: pUSD is transferable Polygon collateral used for settlement on Polymarket and unwraps into USDC.e. Restricted platform use and crypto-asset redemption do not establish a GENIUS exclusion; token-specific holder obligations and legal classification remain unresolved.

genius.notes: Historical 2026-08-14 review: applicability non-payment-token; authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP posture not-applicable. Prior note: No GENIUS authorization was assessed because the reviewed product description makes pUSD platform collateral, not a payment stablecoin. Re-check if pUSD is later externally listed or marketed for general payments, and confirm the token issuer's legal entity. D17 review on 2026-10-01 withdraws that categorical exclusion pending qualified token-specific legal analysis of holder repayment obligations and any US securities or deposit exclusion. Authorization and pathway are separately unknown; no approval or negative authorization census is asserted. Platform-only use and lack of external listing are product facts, not statutory exclusions. The enforcement field remains the historical 2026-08-14 posture and was not refreshed in this applicability review. Re-review on publication of governing holder terms or qualified regulator/legal analysis, otherwise by 2027-01-01.
